remarks: Prime location meets modern living in this completely updated 1-bedroom, 1.5-bath townhouse at The Chesterfield. The main level features a renovated kitchen with high-end stainless steel appliances, cathedral ceilings with a skylight, and a living room with a wood-burning fireplace, recessed lighting, and sliders to an oversized deck ideal for entertaining, along with a separate dining area and half bath. Upstairs offers a bright and spacious bedroom with abundant closet and storage space, plus a spa-like full bath with floor-to-ceiling tile, soaking tub, separate shower, double vanity, quiet fan with Bluetooth speaker, and top-of-the-line finishes. Additional highlights include in-unit washer and dryer and extra space for guests or a home office. This gated Chesterfield community offers two swimming pools, 24-hour security, and exceptional convenience to shopping, transportation, I-95, the Merritt Parkway, and vibrant downtown Stamford-schedule your private showing before it's gone.
